Features
Auto-categorisation

Every transaction lands in the right category without a spreadsheet. Ledgerly learns your chart of accounts and keeps it current as vendors change.

Duplicate detection

Spot the same charge twice before it reaches your books. Ledgerly compares amount, vendor and timing, then flags what needs a human look.

Month-end close

Reconcile the month while it is still fresh, not weeks after it closes. Exceptions surface first, so the close is a review instead of a hunt.
